decision_rule: Responsibility, completion or scope of a checking/quality-assurance procedure is the main object.
boundary: Use Temporal attribution when the main distinction is when an action or instruction took effect.

decision_rule: The age or update scope of the comparison inventory is the main object.
boundary: Use Completeness and mapping for coverage of a mapping within the specified corpus.

decision_rule: The stated basis for including, excluding or consolidating a process or datum is the main object.
boundary: Source-locator precision alone belongs to Referential specificity.

decision_rule: The scope or coverage of a mapping or iterative completeness process is the main object.
boundary: Methodological coherence addresses the wider assessment method rather than mapping coverage alone.

decision_rule: The passage explicitly compares how readily different decision types can be checked or challenged.
boundary: Do not assign this label to a favorable general statement merely because the study concerns auditability.

decision_rule: Different documentary objects contain inconsistent values, categories, model names or source-use conventions.
boundary: Use Data/argument provenance when the central question is the origin, custody or qualification of support.

decision_rule: The origin, custody, qualification or transferability of data, models or supporting arguments is the main object.
boundary: Use Navigability and access when the main concern is a route to an otherwise identified location or object.

decision_rule: The passage evaluates the coherence or international alignment of the overall FEP and scenario method.
boundary: This label does not assert completeness of individual links or uniform justification of exclusions.

decision_rule: Access to, or movement between, documentary objects and treatment locations is the main object.
boundary: Use Referential specificity when an existing reference is too vague to identify the intended treatment.

decision_rule: Descriptions, handling statements or references do not precisely identify the subject or supporting location.
boundary: Use Reproducibility and justification when the missing element is the substantive reasoning or calculation itself.

decision_rule: The documented reasoning or calculation is insufficient to reconstruct or assess the particular assertion.
boundary: An unclear path to existing support alone belongs to Navigability and access or Data/argument provenance.

decision_rule: The date, version or propagation timing of an action, instruction or correction is the main object.
boundary: Do not infer current operational status from a dated historical record.
